command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); foreach(`$p in `$ps){foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$hits=`$o -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^ ?ip route-static|isis cost|mpls te|segment-routing|srv6'}; if(`$hits){Write-Output ('===== '+`$p+' '+`$n+' ====='); Write-Output `$hits}}}"
